path.description: Path to the TRAINING JSONL dataset.
path.title: Path

eval_path.description: Eval / benchmark JSONL to check contamination against. If omitted, the check is skipped (checked=false) rather than failing.
eval_path.title: Eval Path

normalize.description: Whitespace-collapse before hashing (must match dedup's setting).
normalize.title: Normalize

method.description: Contamination method: 'exact' (default — canonical_hash byte-identical match), 'ngram' (word n-gram/shingle Jaccard overlap — also catches reworded/near-duplicate leaks), 'both' (union of the exact and n-gram row sets), or 'minhash' (MinHash+LSH approximate Jaccard overlap via datasketch — the scalable near-dup path for large corpora, catching paraphrased leakage without the O(train x eval) all-pairs shingle comparison; needs the [minhash] extra).
method.title: Method

ngram.description: Shingle window size in words, used when method is 'ngram', 'both' or 'minhash'. 13 matches common near-dup-detection defaults (e.g. GPT-3/RedPajama-style decontamination window sizes).
ngram.title: Ngram

overlap_threshold.description: Jaccard similarity (0-1) at/above which a training row is flagged as near-duplicate contamination, used when method is 'ngram', 'both' or 'minhash' (the MinHash estimate for 'minhash').
overlap_threshold.title: Overlap Threshold

num_perm.description: MinHash permutation count (signature length) — higher is more accurate but slower. Used only when method='minhash'.
num_perm.title: Num Perm
